supplementalSourceReviewEvidence.reviewNote: The global search panel, scope, author/attachment/date filters, and find action match the archived screen. reviewNotes.M15: Profile form and save state are visible with a synthetic identity and no avatar. The source includes a secondary avatar button labelled ‘Удалить…’; code renders this action only when avatar_url is present, so its absence in the after capture is expected and no parity defect is inferred.
reviewNotes.M16: Password and logout sections match the source flow. The after capture adds explicit confirmation guidance and places active sessions below the first viewport; no overlap was observed.
reviewNotes.M17: Device controls and microphone activation layout match. Device names and sensitivity values differ because the after image uses the host browser device inventory and runtime preferences.
reviewNotes.M18: Notification controls and per-channel preferences are present. The source browser has notifications enabled and a channel selected; the after browser denies permission and has no open channel, which changes the visible state.
reviewNotes.M19: About/version card structure matches. The source reports an installed current version; the after capture shows the local update endpoint’s 503 error and is not suitable as a golden.
